Subject: Redwood CPPO — next steps and evidence pack

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising and our procurement has asked for the AWS CPPO artifacts so we can move to an internal purchasing approval. Can you share the standard evidence pack (SOC/Security attestation, data handling, billing contact) and confirm the private offer terms we'll need to provide to our AWS rep? Best,

ResellCo

Eli — thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can support a 4/20 CPPO activation.

I attached a checklist below and will follow up with the evidence bundle and the pricing sheet. High-level asks for your procurement team:
- Confirm billing contact and PO routing (email + AWS billing acct id)
- Provide reseller legal entity name (for CPPO enrollment)
- Confirm whether you need monthly invoices or consolidated billing via AWS Marketplace

I'll loop Ben (channel ops) to coordinate the private offer creation and Camila to compile the security artifacts. Expect a zip with artifacts and a draft MPA by Monday morning.

Next concrete step: Ben, can you own the CPPO creation with the AWS rep and track the DocuSign flow? Camila — please prepare the evidence pack and the short security summary.

Thanks,

Looping in Laura for billing and me for CPPO ops. Quick ops notes:
- I'll open the CPPO request with AWS today and include ResellCo's legal name and AWS account ID. AWS will ask for a contact for entitlement provisioning and the marketplace listing SKU.
- DocuSign packet: we need the MPA & order form signed before AWS publishes; I'll coordinate with your procurement.
- Co-sell badge: AWS requires a validated listing + evidence of joint GTM (one-line partner plan). We can provide a 1-page GTM memo for you to co-sign.

Eli — can you confirm: 1) ResellCo legal name for contract (exact string), 2) contact for entitlement provisioning (name + email), 3) preferred invoice cadence?

I'll create a shared folder and drop tracking artifacts there.

Eli — thanks for the fast responses and the billing contact. Quick answers:
1) Data residency blurb for MPA (paste below for your legal):
"Redwood Inference processes customer data in multiple cloud regions as requested by the customer. Customers may specify region constraints at deployment time; for AWS-hosted CPPO deployments, data processing will be limited to the AWS regions specified in the MPA. Redwood maintains documented controls for cross-border transfers and will execute Data Processing Agreements consistent with GDPR requirements."

2) AWS CPPO publish gating: AWS will only publish the private offer once AWS confirms the MPA and the seller-provided pricing/entitlement fields in the CPPO request. We'll hold the request in draft until we have a signed MPA timestamp from ResellCo. Ben will confirm the publish gating with the AWS rep (cc'd).

Planned immediate next steps:
- Eli / ResellCo: sign the MPA (DocuSign link will come from Ben) and provide billing acct id + Mia's provisioning email.
- Ben: open CPPO request in AWS with draft pricing and hold for signed MPA.
- Camila: escalate full SOC2 under NDA if ResellCo legal requests.

If we hit your 4/20 target we should aim to have MPA signed by 4/12 to allow AWS lead time. I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan and milestone dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Exec, Channel Sales
Redwood Inference
